stages.description: Ordered stages of the plan. Stage titles must match the stage names in the DAG produced during decomposition.

number.description: 1-based position of the stage in the plan.

title.description: Stage name. Must match the corresponding DAG node label.

description.description: One or two sentences describing what the stage achieves.

steps.description: Atomic actions performed in this stage. Group all changes to one repository into a single code step.

type.description: Management surface used by the step: code (infrastructure code change), web (web interface), curl (API request), shell (CLI command), other.

action.description: Markdown describing the step: one summary sentence, a blank line, then a bullet list with one item per file, resource, or distinct change.

command.description: Ready-to-run commands for shell and curl steps, one per line, with no prose, markdown or comments. Omit for code, web and other steps.

repository.description: Repository the coding agent clones for a code step. Required on every code step and unique across the plan.

pr_title.description: Pull request title for a code step, suitable for `gh pr create --title`. Omit for other step types.

comment.description: Optional note for the operator running the step.

items.description: Tool category name (e.g. kubernetes, monitoring, code-repository).

categories.description: Tool categories the sub-agent that executes this action will need. They decide which MCP tools that sub-agent is given, so name every surface the action touches and send an empty array when it needs none. A category left out is a tool the executor will not have.

checks.description: One or two verification checks that prove the stage succeeded.

expectation.description: The result that confirms the stage succeeded.

rollback.description: Actions that revert the whole plan, in the order they must be performed. One code entry per repository.

type.description: Management surface used by the rollback entry.

action.description: Markdown describing the revert: one summary sentence, a blank line, then a bullet list.

command.description: Ready-to-run commands for shell and curl entries, one per line. Omit for code, web and other entries.

repository.description: Repository reverted by a code entry.

pr_title.description: Pull request title for a code rollback entry.

comment.description: Optional note for the operator running the rollback.

items.description: Tool category name (e.g. kubernetes, monitoring, code-repository).

categories.description: Tool categories the sub-agent that executes this action will need. They decide which MCP tools that sub-agent is given, so name every surface the action touches and send an empty array when it needs none. A category left out is a tool the executor will not have.
